5 KOSPI market-wide lower circuit breakers have already been triggered in just 2 months; June and July 2026.

One more would make it six, meaning nearly half of all such events since 2000 happened in this two-month window alone.

Yet somehow, the entire AI & Crypto class is exposed to it as it is the opportunity lol

Market-structure signal: HCH frames frequent KOSPI circuit breakers as a macro opportunity amid crypto/AI exposure. Aligns with their documented bearish positioning (35% portfolio short as of Jul 15).
